name: Clouds
overview: The Scriptures reveal that clouds hold profound significance in the coming of Christ, as seen in the clear declarations that the Son of Man will appear in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory. Matthew 24:30, Matthew 26:64, and Mark 14:62 emphasize that believers will witness Jesus seated at the right hand of power, coming visibly in the clouds, affirming both His divine authority and future return. This imagery highlights clouds as a majestic and powerful symbol associated with God's presence and the fulfillment of His redemptive plan.
